'''Maher''' is a [[Huanglong]] tourist [[NPC]] in [[Capitoline Hill City]], [[Septimont]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
;(First interaction)
:'''Maher:''' Hello! You must be from Huanglong! I'm Maher. A word of advice: don't listen to these [[Vitto|guys]]. I wouldn't lie to a fellow Huanglonger!
:{{DIcon}} You're Mahe?
::'''Maher:''' That's right, I'm Maher! Take it from me. Don't go with those guys to eat any so-called Septimont delicacies.
:{{DIcon}} Do you sell eggs?
::'''Maher:''' What? Eggs? No, no, no, you've got the wrong guy. But listen! Don't go with those guys to eat any so-called Septimont delicacies.
:'''Maher:''' They took me to eat this "sardinpuca"...? "Serdinbaca"...? "[[Saltimbocca]]!" Anyway, the thing felt like it was beating up my tongue!
:'''Maher:''' I'm still hurting from eating that... What kind of seasoning did they put... Hang on. Seasoning...
:'''Maher:''' I got it! I got it! Thank you!
:{{DIcon}} You're welcome?
:{{DIcon}} But I didn't do anything...
----
;(Second interaction)
:'''Maher:''' I've got it! This is a real business opportunity!
:'''Maher:''' Do you know what the rarest commodity is when out at sea? Gold? Fresh fruit? Or...
:{{DIcon}} Spices from Huanglong?
:'''Maher:''' That's right. I've noticed these Septimontians like eating meat with heavy seasoning, and what's more, they like trying new things.
:'''Maher:''' Huanglong spices taste very different from ones here. I've tried adding spices from Huanglong into Saltimbocca, resulting in some unique flavors.
:'''Maher:''' So I want to sell Huanglong spices in Septimont.
:'''Maher:''' What do you think? Will it work?
:{{DIcon}} It'll work.
::'''Maher:''' Wonderful! I'm going to make it big in Septimont!
:{{DIcon}} I need to think about it.
::'''Maher:''' Over time, I'm sure I'll get a solid footing in the Septimont spice market.
:{{DIcon}} So you're an entrepreneur now?
::'''Maher:''' Am I? So are you. I see you also have loads of sundries on your person. Could we be in the same profession?
{{Dialogue End}}
